articles.title_en: The effects of residential landlord–tenant laws: New evidence from Canadian reforms using census data
articles.title_cn: 住宅房东-租客法的影响：基于加拿大普查数据的新证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the consequences of landlord–tenant laws on quality and prices in the rental housing market. We use the staggered introduction of Canadian Residential Tenancy Acts to study the consequences of a landlord–tenant reform that reduced tenants’ litigation costs and improved their bargaining power through mandatory contractual terms. To do so, we employ the difference-in-differences approach to estimate the average treatment effect on a repeated-cross section of households, controlling for income and family structure in five cities. The estimates imply that the reform led to a decline of 2.2 percentage points in the probability of a major defect, with no measurable effect on rent prices or homeownership rates. The average treatment effects are concentrated within families with children, who face greater costs to moving in response to property damage. The results are consistent with a stylized model in which a reduction in litigation costs allows the tenant to more cheaply recover on damages when moving costs are high, with second-generation rent controls limiting increases in rent prices charged by the landlord.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究房东-租客法对租赁住房市场质量和价格的影响。我们利用加拿大住宅租赁法的分阶段引入，研究了一项通过强制性合同条款降低租客诉讼成本并提高其议价能力的房东-租客改革的影响。为此，我们采用双重差分法估计对五个城市中重复横截面家庭的平均处理效应，并控制收入和家庭结构。估计结果表明，该改革导致重大缺陷概率下降2.2个百分点，但对租金价格或自有住房率没有可测量的影响。平均处理效应集中在有子女的家庭中，这些家庭因财产损害而搬家的成本更高。结果与一个简化模型一致，在该模型中，诉讼成本的降低使租客在搬家成本较高时能更便宜地追偿损失，而第二代租金管制限制了房东收取的租金价格上涨。

articles.title_en: The impact of road rationing on housing demand and sorting
articles.title_cn: 道路限行对住房需求与居住分异的影响
articles.abstract_en: Canonical urban models postulate transportation cost as a key element in determining urban spatial structure. This paper examines how road rationing policies impact the spatial distribution of households around transit centers using rich micro data on housing transactions and resident demographics in Beijing. We find that Beijing’s road rationing policy significantly increased the demand for housing near subway stations. The premium for proximity is stable in the periods prior to the driving restriction, but shifts significantly in the aftermath of the policy. The composition of households living close to subway stations shifts towards slightly wealthier households. Our findings suggest that city-wide road rationing policies can have the unintended consequence of limiting access to public transit for lower income individuals.
articles.abstract_cn: 经典城市模型假定交通成本是决定城市空间结构的关键要素。本文利用北京住房交易和居民人口统计的丰富微观数据，考察道路限行政策如何影响家庭围绕交通枢纽的空间分布。我们发现，北京的道路限行政策显著增加了地铁站附近住房的需求。邻近地铁的溢价在限行政策实施前保持稳定，但在政策实施后显著变化。居住在地铁站附近的家庭构成向略微更富裕的家庭转变。我们的研究结果表明，全市范围的道路限行政策可能产生意想不到的后果，即限制低收入人群获得公共交通服务。

articles.title_en: City characteristics, land prices and volatility
articles.title_cn: 城市特征、土地价格与波动性
articles.abstract_en: We develop a model that describes how city characteristics affect the volatility of real estate rents and values. The model includes agglomeration externalities, which amplify the effect of productivity shocks on population growth and rents, as well as city characteristics that constrain population growth. While growth constraints make rents more subject to productivity shocks because of the inelastic supply, they can also suppress the benefits of agglomeration, which has the effect of decreasing the sensitivity of rents to productivity shocks. Our dynamic model exhibits persistent rent growth and rent-to-value ratios that vary across cities and over time. In particular, we show that productivity shocks have a larger initial effect on rents in more constrained cities, but a greater long-term effect in less constrained cities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个模型，描述城市特征如何影响房地产租金和价值的波动性。该模型包括集聚外部性，它放大了生产率冲击对人口增长和租金的影响，以及限制人口增长的城市特征。虽然增长约束因供给缺乏弹性而使租金更易受生产率冲击影响，但它们也可能抑制集聚的收益，从而降低租金对生产率冲击的敏感性。我们的动态模型表现出持续的租金增长和随城市及时间变化的租金价值比。特别是，我们表明，生产率冲击对约束较多城市的租金初始影响更大，但对约束较少城市的长期影响更大。
